f1102-61:
Forget the left-brain/right-brain cartoon

I use the expression ‘syncing the hemispheres’ but don’t want to overinterpret what is going on neuroscientifically. A huge study of resting-state fMRI scans of 1011 people does not support the common pop neuropsych notion that people in general are left- or right-brained. But there is evidence for lateralization of some functions or networks.

Let’s elicit a high level of co-operation between the verbal, the analytical, the imaginal, the emotional, the somatic, the intuitive, the relational, the spiritual … all the modes of your mind. It’s not an electoral process. Nobody needs to win!

The mind of love and the mind of analysis can both be there, so you can be warm and clear-headed at once. The mind of intuition and the mind of rationality can both be there - intuitive signals without dogma, and testing of those signals without killing them. Your body has its own yes and no, and sometimes a not yet. Your imagination can open things up before the adult in you decides what to do in real life.

Analysis with no love in it gets sterile, and love that never stops to analyze anything drifts off into fantasy. The same goes for intuition and testing: signals you never test can turn into delusions, and testing with nothing intuitive to test is dead.

And all of this has got to lead somewhere, to a point where you notice you’re behaving more kindly, you’ve got more humility and better judgment than you had, you’re doing real service, or your ordinary life has gotten more workable.
f1102-119:
The two-hand practice

There is a simple and easy body technique to connect with your inner child. Just place one hand in the center of your chest, which physically connects you to your love, and then place your other hand just below that, on your solar plexus, where your inner child can be.

Imagine a divine Love from above, with the inner child below, in the solar plexus area. The inner adult is present. You can also use the hand on the solar plexus to massage that area.

Begin to send love from your heart down to your inner child and just notice what comes up for you. If some comes back up, let it, and send it on down again, so it goes around like a loop. That part's a gift from them, and they don't owe it to you, so if nothing comes back, just keep sending yours. If you feel resistance, just meet it with love. If you feel or see something, just meet that with love as well. If you can't find any warmth today, just leave your hands where they are and notice what's there. Don't pretend to feel something you don't. Let it go back and forth between your heart and your inner child, like a real conversation.

Keep breathing gently the whole way through. The Sober induction below lists this practice as one of its anchors, so it works as an induction too.
f1102-216:
If you sense you are being influenced

First of all, if you sense you are being hypnotically influenced, stop. Don’t obey immediately, but don’t rebel automatically, just realize that you are being influenced.

Secondly, here are some of the ways people use hypnotic language to manipulate: you consent to something without realizing it, you only get one choice, or someone slips something you never agreed to into a sentence. For example:

“You will soon realize that I am right…” Or “You may, in time, decide to admit that…” Or “The only reason you do not agree is…” Or “Part of you already knows…” Or “Your higher self wants…” Or “Everyone who is awake knows…” Or “The reason you do not believe that is true is because your ego does not want you to…”

If you are unsure, you may like to ask yourself the following questions:

What are they asking me to agree to? What choice are they giving me? What are they assuming that I may not agree with? Who benefits if I comply? What is the emotionally charged part of what they’re saying? What are they leaving out? If I say no, what will the consequences be? (Will they punish me, shame me, laugh at me, leave me out, tell me I’m not ‘awake’ etc?)

And afterwards: do I come away from them more present and grown up, or less? Be extra careful with all this when you’re in a deep or powerful state, because that’s when you need your boundaries most.
f1102-361:
The 15-minute daily practice

You don't need to learn a second script for this. It's the same process (gather your attention, notice what's here, respond, wait, and come all the way back), just for fifteen minutes or so. That is long enough to induce yourself (it only takes a few minutes), practice and let it unfold at its own pace, and come out again (that takes a few minutes too). Fifteen minutes is just a handy appointment with yourself, though, and your feelings don't have to keep to it. Five minutes is plenty to see what happens when you simply sit in silence, listening, and you can interrupt yourself at any time to change direction if that feels better.

You can also try other ways of inducing yourself, such as becoming aware of 3 things you can see, 3 things you can hear, 3 things you can feel in your body; then 2 of each, 1 of each. Then count from 5 to 1 and begin to listen. Choose one way to induce yourself. You don't need to try all of them (in fact, stacking them might be counter-productive).

Once you have practiced listening a few times with the recordings, you may want to shorten them to speed up your induction, or even practice without playing them back at all. On the other hand, if you like using the recordings, there is no reason to stop. (Once you know the induction well, the cue from "A shortcut back into hypnosis" can shorten it too.)

As you come out of the process, ask yourself what needed warmth, what needed to be protected, what you need to do differently to be more in accord with truth and love and life. Is there something you want to explore more fully or a capacity you want to build? And most importantly, what can you now carry yourself that you used to have to borrow? If you identified something you needed to do differently, make a plan with yourself to do that thing. The more specific you can be, the more likely you are to change: “If _________ (fill in the cue for the old pattern), then I will do ________ (fill in a small action that will begin to change the pattern).” Then check back later and see how you are doing – sleeping, relating, functioning, etc., not only how impressive the session felt.
f1102-527:
Pattern 9: Nominalizations

A nominalization turns something you do into a noun: you heal, and it becomes 'healing'. Others are 'safety', 'trust', 'integration', 'communion', 'clarity' and 'rest'. They're a bit vague, and sometimes that's useful, because it lets the listener's subconscious fill in something very specific for them.

"A bit more safety can come to me in whatever way my body understands."

Pattern 10: Meta Model questions — the de-hypnosis tool

Milton Model language opens things up, and Meta Model questions ask what exactly someone means.

You need both to be ethical with people, so when something sounds true but vague, ask: "What do you mean, specifically? According to who? Compared to what? Always, or never? What exactly would happen if you did? How do you know that, and what evidence would change your mind?"

So when someone is starting to tense up in their body, use the Milton Model to help them soften. And when you feel you're losing track of what's really going on, that's the time for the Meta Model.

The personal accounts and the way I arrange this practice are my own, especially adaptations like combining body-oriented work and hypnotic work. This combination is not a scientifically validated form of treatment at this time. The Cochrane Collaboration has not yet awarded me their highest medal of honor.

Learning, entering, and returning

Healing the Divided Self, Maggie Phillips and Claire Frederick (1995), pp 24-27, 45-50, 83-90, covers a lot of aspects of this post, such as interactive hypnosis, helping the subject learn how to learn by using other senses, learning self hypnosis, making sure the subject comes back at the end, etc. However, this is a professional clinical book, not a self help book, so be careful about trying to use the procedures used with the cases, etc in this book for solo work (and the same goes for its historical claims). Also, Adam Eason and Benjamin Parris's article about self hypnosis for the International Society of Hypnosis should be a useful thing to read (especially the parts that talk about how to learn to learn when you're directing it yourself, and about whether you need another person to help you, and using recordings to help you, etc.)

Indirect language and re-entry cues

For information about using indirect hypnotic language patterns, such as pacing, utilizing, metaphor, and associational cues, etc, see Healing the Divided Self, Phillips and Frederick, 1995, pp 53-57, 96-100, as well as Nimja's tutorial on hypnotic language patterns, and his tutorial on triggers. That's where these techniques come from, but don't blame them for every NLP claim here, or for an example that doesn't suit trauma work (Nimja didn't write or endorse this guide). I adapted the language for my own purposes, and I deliberately used a sequence that would be easy to use for re-entry.
c1102-92a:
The inner child, the guards, and the inner adult’s three jobs

Your inner child won’t trust you right away. It’s not going to be enough for you to meditate, say three nice sentences to the inner child and expect to have its trust. What’s going to help your inner child to trust you is you, the person you are right now, becoming reliable.

Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent. Say a party gets to be too much for your little one. The Protector gets you both out of there, and on the way home the Nurturer tells them they did great, even though mostly they hid in the bathroom. And the Guide helps them think twice about the next weird party they might go to, avoiding another cycle of bathroom vacationing. 🙈 It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

Also, your inner child’s worth is not dependent on these qualities… It has its own worth, and its own qualities, like playing, being tender, not taking life too seriously, being creative and wondering at the world. Those belong in your relationship with it too, not just the wounds.

When you want to ask your Guide: “What direction is the most in alignment with truth, love, life and all beings?”

When you want to listen to your intuition: “I ask my intuition to give me a signal, my analytical mind to decipher it, my body to give me feedback on whether my deciphering is correct, and reality to test it.”

When you want to know if a particular intuition you have is coming from your universal heart or from your programming: “I ask my wise subconscious mind to help me see if the intuition or impulse I have about …is coming from my universal heart or from my family, my religion, marketing, erotic programming, my political tribe, my trauma response or an old deal I did as a child to belong. If it’s coming from my programming, I ask the parts responsible for it to step back and soften only as much as is safe, so that I can have true guidance from my universal heart that will help me make my life better in the most simple ways possible. Let my body give me feedback as to the difference.”

Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I do in my ordinary life to show that I heard correctly?” If it tells you to do something, I'd only do it if it's loving and leaves you free. It would have to make sense too. And even with all that, I wouldn't do anything big or hard to undo until I'm calm and I've checked it against what I actually know.

You use the prompt to tell your subconscious what you want in a language it can easily understand. The NLP in Appendix B below can help smooth the prompt's entry and reduce resistance. Used together properly, the subconscious can feel safer in giving its response, though that doesn't make the answers any more true.
